headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis to detect potential security risks and outdated packages, ensuring a safer installation process. Implement automatic binding.gyp command expansion checks for native modules, reducing manual intervention needed. Add support for dynamic lockfile updates based on package version changes, maintaining consistency across development environments.
actions: Implement real-time dependency analysis to identify potential security vulnerabilities and deprecated packages before installation.
Automatically check and expand binding.gyp commands during the install process to ensure native modules are correctly configured without manual intervention.
Enable dynamic lockfile updates that reflect changes in package versions, ensuring all development environments remain consistent.
